flows.name: create a personal activity and open the reliable editor
steps: personal entry creates an activity and opens 当前作品 with no manual save, freeze or persistent save state

flows.name: create, edit, rename, delete and recreate a same-name file with stable identities
steps: a new text file accepts multi-line Chinese through the real clipboard and synchronizes automatically
rename keeps the stable object and content identity
delete removes the current file from the head
same-name recreation receives a new object identity; the deleted tombstone identity is not recycled

flows.name: retain UTF-8 BOM and CRLF of an immutable source while editing and reopening
steps: editing appends text without normalizing the existing BOM and CRLF bytes
reload reads the same immutable source and displays the edited bytes

flows.name: an opened activity survives API disconnection and reload, then continues its pending sync
steps: while the API is unreachable the page reloads from local browser storage with the unpublished input
after reconnecting the original pending sync reaches the service without a refresh

flows.name: late and lost confirmations never settle later editor content
steps: a delayed confirmation settles only its own request; later input is never overwritten or settled
a dropped confirmation is recovered by querying the original request receipt
reload keeps the last protected body

flows.name: continuous input advances durable local and remote content before typing stops
steps: continuous typing advanced 8/30 characters durably before the student stopped

flows.name: macOS Chrome IME composition, newline and focus in the actual editor
steps: composition commits Chinese into the actual Monaco editor
Enter inserts a newline and keeps focus in the editor; the body synchronizes automatically

flows.name: light, dark and narrow layouts keep the actual editor and its controls usable
steps: light and dark page screenshots show the actual editor with Chinese content
narrow viewport shows the editor and file controls with no horizontal occlusion

flows.name: product stop/start keeps the same activity body and object identities
steps: stop/start returns a ready product endpoint and the same body and object identities are readable
reopening the activity from the list after restart shows the last protected Chinese body

flows.name: physical macOS Chinese IME composition, paste, newline, Meta cursor and focus
steps: with the installed Doubao Pinyin input source selected, physical keystrokes composed 你好 and 世界 and committed candidates with Space
Return inserted a newline; Cmd+V pasted 粘贴中文 from the macOS clipboard
Cmd+Left moved the caret to line start and 开始 was composed there; after focusing the filename input and returning to the editor, Cmd+Right and 结束 were composed at line end
the service returned 200 with the final text 你好世界\n开始粘贴中文结束

evidence.inputSourceNote: The live macOS input-source set on this machine includes the installed Doubao Pinyin IME but not Apple SCIM Pinyin; this run used Doubao Pinyin as the physical macOS input method.
evidence.method: OS-level key events via System Events sent to the Playwright-launched Chrome process after activating its pid; IME candidates committed with Space
evidence.text:
你好世界
开始粘贴中文结束
evidence.newline: Return inserted a real newline between 世界 and 开始
evidence.paste: Cmd+V pasted 粘贴中文 from the macOS clipboard
metaCursor: Cmd+Left moved the caret to line start before composing 开始
Cmd+Right moved the caret to line end before composing 结束
evidence.focus: focus moved to the filename input and back to the Monaco textarea; later physical input still landed in the editor
